teamstatus.configuration.title: TeamStatus
teamstatus.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Show the team status overlay on the HUD.
teamstatus.configuration.showSelf.toolti: Show your own status panel pinned at the bottom of the stack. Your mining, eating and attack animations are derived locally, with no extra network traffic.
Horizontal anchor as a percentage of the screen width. 0 = left edge, 100 = right edge. Panels stack upward.
Vertical anchor as a percentage of the screen height. 0 = top edge, 100 = bottom edge (default, bottom-left anchoring).
teamstatus.configuration.edgeInset.toolt: Fixed distance from the anchored screen edges, in GUI-scaled pixels. Default 10 keeps the panels 10 pixels away from the edges.
teamstatus.configuration.verticalGap.too: Vertical gap between stacked teammate panels, in GUI-scaled pixels.
teamstatus.configuration.scale.tooltip: Scale multiplier of the whole team status HUD.
teamstatus.configuration.showEffects.too: Show teammates' potion effect icons and remaining durations.
teamstatus.configuration.showHands.toolt: Show each teammate's main-hand item, including mining and attack animations.
